title: Caldera at sunset is unforgettable
body: Watching the sun melt into the Aegean from Oia is one of those things you remember forever. We stayed at Astra Suites — every terrace has a postcard view.

title: Crowded but worth it
body: Go in May. June onwards is packed, especially at Oia castle. Wine tour at Santo Wines was the surprise highlight.

title: Romantic anniversary trip
body: Private boat to Red Beach, dinner at Selene — perfect. Worth every euro.

title: Overwater dream realised
body: Soneva Jani is unreal. Slide from your villa into the lagoon every morning.

title: Bring snacks
body: Resort food is fantastic but pricey. The reef snorkelling is genuinely world class.

title: Arashiyama at dawn
body: Get to the bamboo grove by 6am. You will have it to yourself and the light is soft.

title: Stayed at Hoshinoya, never want to leave
body: Arrival by river boat sets the tone for the whole stay.

title: Limonata, lemon trees, lemon everything
body: Hike the Path of the Gods, then collapse into pasta in Praiano. Heaven.

title: Mara crossing in front of us
body: Singita's guides positioned us perfectly. Saw thousands of wildebeest cross the river.

title: Yoga + healing was reset I needed
body: Como Shambhala is on another level. Made me reconsider how I work.

title: Moraine Lake at 6am
body: Set an alarm. The reflection is unbeatable before the buses arrive.

title: Aurora over Deplar Farm
body: Hot tub, northern lights, fresh fish dinner. Could not ask for more.

title: Wine + ocean + Table Mountain
body: Three days in the city, three in Stellenbosch. Perfect balance.

title: Fitz Roy hike is worth every blister
body: Tough day out from El Chaltén but the lagoon at the top is otherworldly.

title: Royal Mansour is in a league of its own
body: Three storey private riad with butler service. The hammam was transcendent.

title: Adrenaline + wine in one day
body: Bungee in the morning, Gibbston cellars in the afternoon. Only Queenstown can do that.

title: Best caldera views on the island
body: Suite 9 has the corner cliff position. Worth requesting at booking.

title: Private pool made it
body: Mornings in the plunge pool watching the cruise ships drift past — yes please.

title: Pinch-me kind of place
body: Retractable bedroom roof opened to a sky full of stars. Cried a little.

title: Boat arrival sets the mood
body: Ten minutes downriver and you forget the city even exists.

title: River villa is everything
body: Floating breakfast over the Ayung River. Service is intuitive without ever being intrusive.

title: Heli-skiing dream
body: Best snow conditions of my life. The lodge food after each day was a love letter.

title: Wine gallery alone is worth it
body: Private tasting through 7,500 South African wines. Ellerman set a new bar.

title: Tunnels under the gardens
body: Staff move via underground passages so the guests never see service. Such a thoughtful detail.
